lines.en: I'm downstairs. My friend is early.
lines.zh: 我在楼下。我的朋友早到了。
我们看到一把很好看的椅子。
现在下午三点，我到家了。

lines.en: My husband is in the kitchen. Dinner is at 7pm.
lines.zh: 我老公在厨房。晚饭七点吃。

dialogue.title: 家长来早了
dialogue.setting: 星期五下午四点，林太太来补习中心接孩子，她第一次来。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Good afternoon! How can I help you?
lines.zh: 下午好！有什么可以帮你？

lines.speaker: Mrs Lim
lines.en: Hi. I'm downstairs. Which floor is it?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The class is upstairs. Please take the lift.
lines.zh: 教室在楼上。请坐电梯上来。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The class ends at 5pm. Please take a seat.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The toilet is near the lift.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lim
lines.en: Thank you. How much is the book?
